Service policy

Know what to agree before your project begins.

Updated 11 October 2026

Scope and pricingPaymentsRevisions and changesTimelines and collaborationCancellation and refundsHandover and ownershipSupport and maintenanceQuestions or concerns

Scope and pricing

The service cards list our prices in USD and their billing units. Your proposal identifies the deliverables, inclusions and exclusions for the service you choose. Digital marketing and website management are quoted to your needs. Equipment, domains and third-party licences are separate charges.

Payments

Your proposal sets out the payment schedule and payment arrangements. The website does not take online payments or collect payment card details. Ask us to confirm payment instructions directly if you are unsure.

Revisions and changes

Included revision rounds are defined in your proposal. If requirements change, we discuss the effect on deliverables, timing and cost before proceeding.

Timelines and collaboration

We agree milestones and review points for your project, including the content, feedback and access needed from you. Timelines depend on the agreed scope and collaboration requirements.

Cancellation and refunds

Cancellation, rescheduling and refund arrangements must be set out in your project proposal before work begins. No universal refund period or cancellation fee is stated on this website. Ask for these terms before committing or making a payment. For an existing project, contact us with your project details so we can review the agreed arrangements.

Handover and ownership

Your proposal defines the files, documentation and account access to be handed over, ownership and licensing terms, and any continuing third-party charges. Confirm these details before work begins.

Support and maintenance

Website management, hosting, managed IT and digital marketing are available as separately scoped services. Any included support, service boundaries and ongoing billing should be specified in your agreement.

Questions or concerns

Email info@fusionlabs.co.zw with your project name and a description of your question or concern. Include the outcome you are seeking so we can review it against your proposal.
